LanguageData.WotF_EngineeringResonanceCore.descriptio: A polyhedral core recovered from the depths of an ancient ruin. No modern craft can replicate it, yet it is an indispensable cornerstone for building a starlight altar.\nEven after ages of slumber, it emits a steady, low hum whenever mana draws near.
LanguageData.WotF_EngineeringResonanceCore.label: engineering-station resonance core
LanguageData.WotF_RitualAltar_LivingWood.description: A second-tier, single-tile altar carved from livingwood atop a stone pedestal. Its living grain channels mana far better than ordinary timber, allowing the transmutation of elven steel and higher-tier ritual chalk as well as all tier-two and lower rituals.
LanguageData.WotF_RitualAltar_LivingWood.label: livingwood altar
LanguageData.WotF_RitualAltar_Starlight.description: A third-tier, single-tile altar built from livingwood, elven steel, and an engineering-station resonance core. The slumbering core hums low within the plinth, steadying ambient mana enough to transmute adamantine and mithril and sustain all rituals up to tier three.
LanguageData.WotF_RitualAltar_Starlight.label: starlight altar
LanguageData.WotF_RitualElvenStatue.description: An elven figure finely carved from livingwood and jade. It serves as an artistic meditation focus and adds resonance strength to a nearby altar based on its quality. Up to 6 statues can link to one altar.
LanguageData.WotF_RitualElvenStatue.label: elven ritual statue
LanguageData.WotF_RitualLivingwoodLamp.description: A ritual fixture holding a jade lantern atop a livingwood pillar, casting a soft verdigris glow year-round. Placed near an altar, each lamp adds 2 resonance strength; up to 4 lamps can link to one altar.
LanguageData.WotF_RitualLivingwoodLamp.label: livingwood ritual lamp
